verdicts.reason: A shrinks the bottle to a tiny icon jammed in the top-right circle, so the key product is lost. The headline breaks to leave 'fizz' orphaned on its own line, and the body copy is crammed into the bottom-left corner over the peach circle, close to the edge. B keeps the bottle large and layered over the circle, with a clear left-image, right-text banner layout. But the SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline at nearly the same weight, which breaks the reading order and makes the two compete. 'fizz' is still orphaned, and the right-hand column is tight.
